amendment_reason: Independent review reproduced a synthetic TOCTOU pass where a DBN changed after initial verification but before path-based decode, found that reviewed source/test SHAs were not execution-gated, and found incomplete lexical/reparse checks for frozen inputs and output ancestors. These are pre-outcome engineering defects. No live Stage0 ledger or market outcome exists, so this amendment changes no hypothesis, feature, threshold, event, data contract or economic gate.

parent_owned_post_review_artifact.launch_contract: CLI must require both --run-authority and --expected-run-authority-sha256. Before any raw file open, validate the exact receipt bytes/SHA and all bound packet, amendment, analyzer, test, interpreter and Databento version/path fields. Revalidate the receipt and every bound file immediately before publishing outputs.

required_fixes.contract: For each nonempty DBN, validate lexical/canonical/no-reparse path and file identity; open/read the compressed bytes once, compute size/SHA from those exact bytes, require the manifest binding, and decode those exact in-memory bytes with databento.DBNStore.from_bytes. After decode, revalidate lexical path, no-reparse ancestry, file identity, size and SHA before accepting the records. The feature ledger must bind the exact byte hash actually passed to the decoder. A mutation cannot yield PASS, even if it occurs between initial validation and decode.

Require the parent-owned post-review run-authority receipt and its expected SHA at CLI execution. Verify the approved analyzer and tests SHAs plus base/amendment packet SHAs before analysis and immediately before output publication. Reject absent, unapproved, stale, altered or self-invented authority. Tests may use an explicit synthetic authority fixture, but production CLI may not auto-create or infer authority.

Use one Windows-aware path validator for every frozen input, raw file, run-authority, analyzer/test path and output path. Require lexical equality to the exact expected absolute path, resolved containment on D:, and walk every existing ancestor/component with lstat/GetFileAttributes semantics to reject symlink, junction, mount-point or other reparse components. Recheck output ancestors immediately before atomic publication; do not accept an alias merely because resolve() reaches the canonical target.

Production CLI must require the exact canonical relative interpreter `02. AlphaFactory/runtime/python-databento/Scripts/python.exe`, interpreter SHA256 0B471133E110CFB53A061CAD528CE8E517D7B9AC41A0A396C39AD795A487FC14, Python version recorded in the later run authority, and databento==0.54.0 before raw decode. Synthetic unit tests may inject loaders but must test the production runtime gate separately.

red_first_acceptance_tests: Reproduce the review attack: mutate/replace a DBN after initial binding and before decode. The run must fail closed and publish no output.
The bytes hashed against the manifest are the exact bytes passed to DBNStore.from_bytes; path-based DBNStore.from_file is forbidden in production analysis.
Mutating/replacing a DBN after decode but before acceptance fails identity/size/SHA checks; swapping an alias/reparse component anywhere in the raw path fails.
Missing run authority, wrong expected receipt SHA, wrong approved analyzer/test SHA, altered base/amendment packet, non-PASS review verdict or live_stage0_authorized=false blocks before raw open.
Changing analyzer or test bytes after initial authority validation but before publication blocks all output publication.
Lexically different aliases, symlinks, junctions, mount points and reparse output ancestors are rejected even when resolve() reaches the expected target.
Wrong interpreter path/SHA/version or databento version blocks production CLI before raw open.
All original 26 focused tests and all V2 adversarial tests pass; no live 658-file run occurs during implementation or review.
prohibitions: Do not use Grok or any Grok skill/worker.
Do not run the analyzer against the live 658 raw files or create final Stage0 outputs before a fresh independent PASS and parent-owned launch receipt.
Do not read EURUSD/outcomes, validation source, middle-window data or 2023+ data.
Do not modify the base packet, preregistration, registry, acquisition evidence, raw DBN files, clocks or unrelated files.
Do not call network/Databento clients, stage, commit, push, branch, worktree or clone.
